description: Source code implementing huge memory allocation management in jemalloc, including functions for malloc, realloc, deallocation, and internal data structures for tracking huge allocations.

methods.name: huge_malloc
methods.description: Allocates huge memory chunks, delegating to huge_palloc.

methods.name: huge_palloc
methods.description: Allocates one or more contiguous chunks for a request, tracking the allocation in a tree.

methods.name: huge_ralloc_no_move
methods.description: Determines if reallocation can avoid moving the memory based on size classes.

methods.name: huge_ralloc
methods.description: Reallocates huge memory, possibly using mremap or copying, with support for alignment and zeroing.

methods.name: huge_dalloc
methods.description: Deallocates huge memory, removing it from tracking structures and optionally unmapping.

methods.name: huge_salloc
methods.description: Returns the size of a huge allocation.

methods.name: huge_dss_prec_get
methods.description: Gets the DSS (Dedicated Storage Segment) priority for an arena.

methods.name: huge_prof_ctx_get
methods.description: Retrieves profiling context for a huge allocation.

methods.name: huge_prof_ctx_set
methods.description: Sets profiling context for a huge allocation.

methods.name: huge_prefork
methods.description: Prepares the huge allocator for a fork.
